title.en: Weton Story Preferences & Calendar Reference

seoTitle.en: Weton Story Quiz: 35 Original Readings & Calendar | FermatMind
seoTitle.zh: Weton故事测试：35种原创读法与历法｜费马测试

description.en: 35 original fictional choices, every highest-tied story in full, and a separate optional Javanese calendar reference. No birth-personality verdict.
description.zh: 35题原创虚构选择，完整保留全部最高并列故事，另有独立可选爪哇历法参考，不据出生日期判断人格。

introduction.en: Explore seven weekday story roles and five pasaran lenses as original cultural fiction. Read all 35 complete bilingual guides for free, and compare a separate calendar reference without turning it into a personality claim.
introduction.zh: 把七个星期故事角色与五个市日视角当作原创文化趣味来比较。35篇双语指南全文免费；独立历法参考也可查看，不把日期转成人格判断。

instructions.en: Choose the contribution or focus you would most like to try in 35 fictional scenes. The first 21 choices compare seven original weekday roles, each offered nine times. The next 14 compare five original pasaran lenses, each offered fourteen times. These assignments are FermatMind story devices, not traditional personality keys. Complete all 35 responses; any unscored choice withholds both personal rankings while all 35 full guides remain public. Every highest role is paired with every highest lens, without a forced single winner. Alternatives shuffle after Start and stay stable while going back. A separate optional Gregorian date reference uses explicit relation to local sunset; it never changes story results. No birthdate is required for the quiz.
instructions.zh: 在35个虚构场景中，选择较想尝试的贡献或关注。前21题比较七个原创星期角色，各出现九次；后14题比较五个原创市日视角，各出现十四次。这些配对是费马故事装置，不是传统人格计分键。全部35题回应后才出结果；任一未评分会暂不显示两组个人排名，35篇全文仍公开。所有最高角色与所有最高视角交叉配对，不强派唯一赢家。开始后选项打乱，返回修改时顺序保持。独立可选公历参考需明确与当地日落的关系，不改变故事结果；问卷无需生日。

title.en: Senin Legi Story Guide: Recorder and Arrival | FermatMind
title.zh: Senin Legi故事指南：留存者与初来｜费马测试

description.en: Read the full original Senin Legi fictional story guide, counterexample, counting method, neptu reference and cultural limits. No birth-personality claim.
description.zh: 阅读Senin Legi完整原创虚构故事、反例、计数方法、neptu参考与文化范围，不据出生日期判断人格。

title.en: An original story index, not a birth personality
title.zh: 原创故事索引，不是出生人格

paragraphs.en: Senin Legi is one of this edition’s thirty-five original story combinations. It joins the recorder role with an arrival lens. Imagine that a newcomer finds an unsigned label beside a borrowed lantern. The pairing asks what you would want to make visible in that scene, without saying that the characters were born on this calendar combination. The names organise an invented reading, not an official Primbon character description, a validated personality type or a statement about Javanese people. You may enjoy the combination, disagree with it or read another guide without changing any private answers.
paragraphs.zh: Senin Legi是本版三十五个原创故事组合之一，把留存者角色与初来视角放在一起。想象：新来者在借来灯笼旁看见未署名标签。组合邀请你看这个场景里想让什么变得可见，并不说角色出生于此历日。名称组织原创读法，不是官方Primbon性格、已验证人格类型或对爪哇人的判断。你可以喜欢、不认同或读其他指南，不必改变私人答案。

title.en: The weekday role in this edition

paragraphs.en: The Recorder role gives a fictional place a traceable account. You might want to know who wrote a label, which version of a story is being repeated, or why a repaired object has acquired a new name. The attraction is to provenance rather than collecting every detail. In this edition, choosing a recording action means that this particular scene made a record appealing. It does not establish superior memory, historical expertise or an obligation to document other people. A useful record can be short and revisable, with a visible gap where nobody knows the answer. Keeping that gap can matter more than producing an impressive complete story.
paragraphs.zh: 留存者让虚构地点拥有可追溯的记录：标签由谁写、故事是哪一版、修好的物件为何换了名字。这里吸引人的是来处，不是把所有细节收尽。选中记录行动只说明当前场景让这种做法显得合意，不证明记忆力、历史专业能力，也不要求记录他人生活。一条有用记录可以很短、可以修订；没人知道的地方留下空白，往往比编出完整故事更合适。

title.en: The pasaran lens in this edition

paragraphs.en: Arrival directs a fictional scene toward its threshold: what a newcomer notices first, what they are free to ask and how they can remain undecided. An entrance can be a sign, a first page or a pause before joining, rather than a geographical direction to follow. In this original edition, Legi indexes that lens for organising stories. The documented east association supplies cultural context, not the arrival preference itself. Someone can enjoy a threshold story while disliking real travel, change or crowds. The scene becomes more specific when you name what makes the entrance understandable and which choices remain open after it.
paragraphs.zh: 初来视角把虚构场景放在门槛：新来者先看见什么、可以自由问什么、如何暂不决定。入口可以是招牌、第一页或加入前的停顿，不是让你现实中朝某方向走。本原创版用Legi索引这种故事视角；文献中的东方关联只是文化背景，并不提供这项偏好。喜欢门槛故事，不表示喜欢现实旅行、变化或人群；说清入口哪里易懂、进去后保留哪些选择，会让场景更具体。

title.en: A scene specific to this pairing

paragraphs.en: In this particular scene, one possible contribution is to ask whether the owner wants a short origin note or prefers the label blank. Notice what that leaves undecided: the people involved still control their words, objects and participation. Compare a second version in which the same contribution is unnecessary or unwanted. The difference helps you locate the appeal of the story more precisely than a flattering character label would. You can also move the scene into a purely invented setting, with no real names or personal records. The aim is an interesting comparison, not a recommendation to reproduce the scene or judge somebody who would choose differently.
paragraphs.zh: 在这个具体场景里，一种贡献是：问主人想写简短来处，还是保留空白。同时看它没有替别人决定什么：相关角色仍掌握自己的话、物件和参与。再比较一个同样贡献并不需要、甚至不受欢迎的版本；两者差异，比好听的性格标签更能定位故事吸引力。你也可把它放进完全虚构的地点，不用真实姓名或记录。目标是有趣的比较，不是要求复现场景，或评价不同选择的人。

title.en: A useful counterexample

paragraphs.en: A record can become a burden when the characters need an answer now and you keep expanding the archive. A counterexample is a missing label that nobody wants restored: preserving the uncertainty may respect the object’s present use better than inventing an origin. Ask which single detail changes the scene before deciding that more documentation would improve it.
paragraphs.zh: 记录也会变成负担：角色现在需要答案，你却不断扩充档案。反例是一张没人想复原的遗失标签；保留不确定性，可能比编造来源更尊重物件现在的用途。先问哪一个细节会改变场景，再决定是否值得继续记录。

title.en: Read both choice banks and every tie
title.zh: 分别阅读两组计数与全部并列

paragraphs.en: The first twenty-one comparisons offer three weekday-role actions each. Every role appears nine times, three in each original option position; each pair of roles meets three times. The remaining fourteen comparisons offer all five pasaran lenses each time. Choose one offered action to add one count to its key. Compare the two banks separately: their counts sum to twenty-one and fourteen, so they must not be combined into one ranking. Every highest weekday role is paired with every highest pasaran lens. For example, two tied roles and two tied lenses produce four full readings. Any unscored answer withholds both personal rankings, without filling in zero or guessing a winner.
paragraphs.zh: 前二十一题每题提供三个星期角色行动，每角色出现九次，在原始各位置各三次；每对角色同场三次。后十四题每题提供全部五个市日视角。选中行动给对应键加一次。两组分别比较：计数合计分别二十一与十四，不混成一个排名。每个最高星期角色与每个最高市日视角都组合，例如两角色并列、两视角并列，显示四篇全文。任一未评分会暂不显示两组任何个人计数、排名或匹配，不补零、不猜赢家。

title.en: Calendar, neptu and sunset reference

paragraphs.en: The separate calendar reference uses a Gregorian date, a seven-day week and the repeating five-day sequence Legi, Pahing, Pon, Wage, Kliwon. For Senin Legi, the displayed neptu reference is 4 + 5 = 9; this is a conventional sum, not an energy score. The cited Yogyakarta heritage account associates Legi with the east. That is cultural context, not a lucky travel direction. Because a traditional day begins at local sunset, an unknown relation to sunset leaves two possible references. No fixed clock time, device timezone or birth personality is inferred, and a date calculation never changes story counts.
paragraphs.zh: 独立历法工具使用公历日期、七日星期，以及Legi、Pahing、Pon、Wage、Kliwon五日循环。Senin Legi的neptu参考为4＋5＝9，这是传统数字相加，不是能量分。所引日惹遗产资料把Legi与东方关联；这是文化背景，不是个人吉利行进方向。传统日界在当地日落，无法确认与日落关系时保留两个可能参考，不猜固定钟点、设备时区或出生人格；日期计算也不改变故事计数。

title.en: A private reflection and the edition’s limits

paragraphs.en: If you want to continue privately, write one sentence about what appealed to you in this pairing and one sentence about when it would not help. Keep both sentences provisional; no upload, purchase or repeated attempt is needed. These original prompts and bilingual guides have no established psychometric validation, population norms or cross-language equivalence. Cultural references support calendar facts and a bounded account of tradition, not the invented role-to-day or lens-to-pasaran assignments. The result cannot determine fate, compatibility, health, marriage dates or another person’s character. Your actual date reference and your fictional story preferences may differ; neither needs to correct the other.
paragraphs.zh: 若想私下继续，写一句这个组合哪里吸引你，再写一句它何时不合适，两句都暂时保留；无需上传、购买或反复重测。本原创题本与双语指南未建立心理测量验证、人群常模或跨语言等价。文化资料支持历法事实和有限的传统背景，不支持本版虚构的角色—星期、视角—市日配对。结果不决定命运、匹配、健康、婚期或他人性格。真实日期参考与虚构故事偏好可以不同，彼此无需纠正。

title.en: An original story index, not a birth personality
title.zh: 原创故事索引，不是出生人格

paragraphs.en: Senin Kliwon is one of this edition’s thirty-five original story combinations. It joins the recorder role with an perspectives lens. Imagine that a table displays three versions of a market’s opening story. The pairing asks what you would want to make visible in that scene, without saying that the characters were born on this calendar combination. The names organise an invented reading, not an official Primbon character description, a validated personality type or a statement about Javanese people. You may enjoy the combination, disagree with it or read another guide without changing any private answers.
paragraphs.zh: Senin Kliwon是本版三十五个原创故事组合之一，把留存者角色与众声视角放在一起。想象：一张桌展示集市开场故事的三个版本。组合邀请你看这个场景里想让什么变得可见，并不说角色出生于此历日。名称组织原创读法，不是官方Primbon性格、已验证人格类型或对爪哇人的判断。你可以喜欢、不认同或读其他指南，不必改变私人答案。

title.en: The weekday role in this edition

paragraphs.en: The Recorder role gives a fictional place a traceable account. You might want to know who wrote a label, which version of a story is being repeated, or why a repaired object has acquired a new name. The attraction is to provenance rather than collecting every detail. In this edition, choosing a recording action means that this particular scene made a record appealing. It does not establish superior memory, historical expertise or an obligation to document other people. A useful record can be short and revisable, with a visible gap where nobody knows the answer. Keeping that gap can matter more than producing an impressive complete story.
paragraphs.zh: 留存者让虚构地点拥有可追溯的记录：标签由谁写、故事是哪一版、修好的物件为何换了名字。这里吸引人的是来处，不是把所有细节收尽。选中记录行动只说明当前场景让这种做法显得合意，不证明记忆力、历史专业能力，也不要求记录他人生活。一条有用记录可以很短、可以修订；没人知道的地方留下空白，往往比编出完整故事更合适。

title.en: The pasaran lens in this edition

paragraphs.en: Perspectives directs a fictional scene toward a place where accounts can remain distinct while being visible together. A shared table need not produce one agreed story; it can display differences without ranking the speakers. Kliwon indexes this original lens, with the documented central position serving as cultural context. It does not prove balance, wisdom or a special spiritual status. Name whose perspective is present and whose is absent. A useful centre can have an empty seat, an unanswered question or an account that is deliberately not collected. The point is a particular arrangement of viewpoints in an imagined scene, not a duty to mediate real disputes.
paragraphs.zh: 众声视角关注不同讲法如何同时可见、又各自独立。一张公共桌不必生成统一故事，也可以展示差异而不排名发言者。Kliwon索引本原创视角，文献中的中央位置只是文化背景，不证明平衡、智慧或特殊灵性地位。说清谁在场、谁缺席；有用的中心可以留空位、留问题，或明确不收集某人的经历。这是虚构视角的安排，不是调解现实争端的义务。

title.en: A scene specific to this pairing

paragraphs.en: In this particular scene, one possible contribution is to give each account its own attribution without inventing a final verdict. Notice what that leaves undecided: the people involved still control their words, objects and participation. Compare a second version in which the same contribution is unnecessary or unwanted. The difference helps you locate the appeal of the story more precisely than a flattering character label would. You can also move the scene into a purely invented setting, with no real names or personal records. The aim is an interesting comparison, not a recommendation to reproduce the scene or judge somebody who would choose differently.
paragraphs.zh: 在这个具体场景里，一种贡献是：各自署明来源，不编造终局判定。同时看它没有替别人决定什么：相关角色仍掌握自己的话、物件和参与。再比较一个同样贡献并不需要、甚至不受欢迎的版本；两者差异，比好听的性格标签更能定位故事吸引力。你也可把它放进完全虚构的地点，不用真实姓名或记录。目标是有趣的比较，不是要求复现场景，或评价不同选择的人。

title.en: A useful counterexample

paragraphs.en: A record can become a burden when the characters need an answer now and you keep expanding the archive. A counterexample is a missing label that nobody wants restored: preserving the uncertainty may respect the object’s present use better than inventing an origin. Ask which single detail changes the scene before deciding that more documentation would improve it.
paragraphs.zh: 记录也会变成负担：角色现在需要答案，你却不断扩充档案。反例是一张没人想复原的遗失标签；保留不确定性，可能比编造来源更尊重物件现在的用途。先问哪一个细节会改变场景，再决定是否值得继续记录。

title.en: Read both choice banks and every tie
title.zh: 分别阅读两组计数与全部并列

paragraphs.en: The first twenty-one comparisons offer three weekday-role actions each. Every role appears nine times, three in each original option position; each pair of roles meets three times. The remaining fourteen comparisons offer all five pasaran lenses each time. Choose one offered action to add one count to its key. Compare the two banks separately: their counts sum to twenty-one and fourteen, so they must not be combined into one ranking. Every highest weekday role is paired with every highest pasaran lens. For example, two tied roles and two tied lenses produce four full readings. Any unscored answer withholds both personal rankings, without filling in zero or guessing a winner.
paragraphs.zh: 前二十一题每题提供三个星期角色行动，每角色出现九次，在原始各位置各三次；每对角色同场三次。后十四题每题提供全部五个市日视角。选中行动给对应键加一次。两组分别比较：计数合计分别二十一与十四，不混成一个排名。每个最高星期角色与每个最高市日视角都组合，例如两角色并列、两视角并列，显示四篇全文。任一未评分会暂不显示两组任何个人计数、排名或匹配，不补零、不猜赢家。

title.en: Calendar, neptu and sunset reference

paragraphs.en: The separate calendar reference uses a Gregorian date, a seven-day week and the repeating five-day sequence Legi, Pahing, Pon, Wage, Kliwon. For Senin Kliwon, the displayed neptu reference is 4 + 8 = 12; this is a conventional sum, not an energy score. The cited Yogyakarta heritage account associates Kliwon with the centre. That is cultural context, not a lucky travel direction. Because a traditional day begins at local sunset, an unknown relation to sunset leaves two possible references. No fixed clock time, device timezone or birth personality is inferred, and a date calculation never changes story counts.
paragraphs.zh: 独立历法工具使用公历日期、七日星期，以及Legi、Pahing、Pon、Wage、Kliwon五日循环。Senin Kliwon的neptu参考为4＋8＝12，这是传统数字相加，不是能量分。所引日惹遗产资料把Kliwon与中央关联；这是文化背景，不是个人吉利行进方向。传统日界在当地日落，无法确认与日落关系时保留两个可能参考，不猜固定钟点、设备时区或出生人格；日期计算也不改变故事计数。

title.en: A private reflection and the edition’s limits

paragraphs.en: If you want to continue privately, write one sentence about what appealed to you in this pairing and one sentence about when it would not help. Keep both sentences provisional; no upload, purchase or repeated attempt is needed. These original prompts and bilingual guides have no established psychometric validation, population norms or cross-language equivalence. Cultural references support calendar facts and a bounded account of tradition, not the invented role-to-day or lens-to-pasaran assignments. The result cannot determine fate, compatibility, health, marriage dates or another person’s character. Your actual date reference and your fictional story preferences may differ; neither needs to correct the other.
paragraphs.zh: 若想私下继续，写一句这个组合哪里吸引你，再写一句它何时不合适，两句都暂时保留；无需上传、购买或反复重测。本原创题本与双语指南未建立心理测量验证、人群常模或跨语言等价。文化资料支持历法事实和有限的传统背景，不支持本版虚构的角色—星期、视角—市日配对。结果不决定命运、匹配、健康、婚期或他人性格。真实日期参考与虚构故事偏好可以不同，彼此无需纠正。

The scene becomes more specific when you name what makes the entrance understandable and which choices remain open after it.

paragraphs.en: The Host role pays attention to how someone can enter a shared scene without having to guess every custom. A chair placed where it can be found, a welcome that leaves room for refusal or a simple explanation of what happens next can change the imagined experience. This role concerns an invitation with a usable boundary. It does not mean you are always sociable, responsible for everyone’s feelings or available to visitors. A quiet welcome and an explicit closing time can coexist. Choosing the hosting action may express a preference for understandable participation in one story, while another story makes solitude, observation or a different task more appealing.
paragraphs.zh: 迎接者在意别人如何进入共同场景，而不必猜遍所有规矩。容易找到的椅子、允许拒绝的邀请、对下一步的简短说明，都能改变想象中的体验。这里是有边界的邀请，不表示你永远外向、负责所有人的感受或随时接待。安静的欢迎可以与明确结束时间并存。某题选择迎接，只说明这个故事里你偏好让参与变得易懂；另一题完全可以偏好独处、旁观或别的任务。

title.en: The pasaran lens in this edition

paragraphs.en: Agreement directs a fictional scene toward a shared understanding that can be checked. A lending note, an agreed closing time or a short statement of what is being exchanged gives characters something they can accept, question or decline. Pahing indexes this original lens; its documented south association does not establish that people born on that pasaran seek agreement. An appealing arrangement need not be unanimous or permanent. Name what each participant has actually accepted, what is still provisional and what happens when someone changes their mind. A story can become more convincing when it allows an agreement to end without turning the departure into a moral failure.
paragraphs.zh: 约定视角关注可核对的共同理解：借用便条、结束时间或交换内容，让角色能够接受、提问或拒绝。Pahing在这里索引原创视角；文献中的南方关联不证明该日出生者偏好约定。合意安排不必全体一致或永久有效。说清各人实际接受了什么、什么仍是暂定、改变主意后怎么办；允许约定结束而不把离开写成道德失败，故事反而更可信。

title.en: A scene specific to this pairing

paragraphs.en: In this particular scene, one possible contribution is to ask participants which invitation details they want made explicit. Notice what that leaves undecided: the people involved still control their words, objects and participation. Compare a second version in which the same contribution is unnecessary or unwanted. The difference helps you locate the appeal of the story more precisely than a flattering character label would. You can also move the scene into a purely invented setting, with no real names or personal records. The aim is an interesting comparison, not a recommendation to reproduce the scene or judge somebody who would choose differently.
paragraphs.zh: 在这个具体场景里，一种贡献是：问参与者希望邀请写清哪些细节。同时看它没有替别人决定什么：相关角色仍掌握自己的话、物件和参与。再比较一个同样贡献并不需要、甚至不受欢迎的版本；两者差异，比好听的性格标签更能定位故事吸引力。你也可把它放进完全虚构的地点，不用真实姓名或记录。目标是有趣的比较，不是要求复现场景，或评价不同选择的人。

title.en: A useful counterexample

paragraphs.en: An invitation can feel demanding when the other character wants to watch quietly or leave. A counterexample gives that character an obvious exit and no request to explain. The Host’s role is then to make refusal easy rather than improve the invitation repeatedly. Welcoming someone does not require deciding what a good guest should do.
paragraphs.zh: 当另一个角色只想旁观或离开，邀请也会像要求。反例应给对方明显出口，不要求解释；迎接者此时应让拒绝容易，而不是不断改善邀请。欢迎别人，不意味着替对方决定怎样才算好客人。

title.en: Read both choice banks and every tie
title.zh: 分别阅读两组计数与全部并列

paragraphs.en: The first twenty-one comparisons offer three weekday-role actions each. Every role appears nine times, three in each original option position; each pair of roles meets three times. The remaining fourteen comparisons offer all five pasaran lenses each time. Choose one offered action to add one count to its key. Compare the two banks separately: their counts sum to twenty-one and fourteen, so they must not be combined into one ranking. Every highest weekday role is paired with every highest pasaran lens. For example, two tied roles and two tied lenses produce four full readings. Any unscored answer withholds both personal rankings, without filling in zero or guessing a winner.
paragraphs.zh: 前二十一题每题提供三个星期角色行动，每角色出现九次，在原始各位置各三次；每对角色同场三次。后十四题每题提供全部五个市日视角。选中行动给对应键加一次。两组分别比较：计数合计分别二十一与十四，不混成一个排名。每个最高星期角色与每个最高市日视角都组合，例如两角色并列、两视角并列，显示四篇全文。任一未评分会暂不显示两组任何个人计数、排名或匹配，不补零、不猜赢家。

title.en: Calendar, neptu and sunset reference

paragraphs.en: The separate calendar reference uses a Gregorian date, a seven-day week and the repeating five-day sequence Legi, Pahing, Pon, Wage, Kliwon. For Rabu Pahing, the displayed neptu reference is 7 + 9 = 16; this is a conventional sum, not an energy score. The cited Yogyakarta heritage account associates Pahing with the south. That is cultural context, not a lucky travel direction. Because a traditional day begins at local sunset, an unknown relation to sunset leaves two possible references. No fixed clock time, device timezone or birth personality is inferred, and a date calculation never changes story counts.
paragraphs.zh: 独立历法工具使用公历日期、七日星期，以及Legi、Pahing、Pon、Wage、Kliwon五日循环。Rabu Pahing的neptu参考为7＋9＝16，这是传统数字相加，不是能量分。所引日惹遗产资料把Pahing与南方关联；这是文化背景，不是个人吉利行进方向。传统日界在当地日落，无法确认与日落关系时保留两个可能参考，不猜固定钟点、设备时区或出生人格；日期计算也不改变故事计数。

title.en: A private reflection and the edition’s limits

paragraphs.en: If you want to continue privately, write one sentence about what appealed to you in this pairing and one sentence about when it would not help. Keep both sentences provisional; no upload, purchase or repeated attempt is needed. These original prompts and bilingual guides have no established psychometric validation, population norms or cross-language equivalence. Cultural references support calendar facts and a bounded account of tradition, not the invented role-to-day or lens-to-pasaran assignments. The result cannot determine fate, compatibility, health, marriage dates or another person’s character. Your actual date reference and your fictional story preferences may differ; neither needs to correct the other.
paragraphs.zh: 若想私下继续，写一句这个组合哪里吸引你，再写一句它何时不合适，两句都暂时保留；无需上传、购买或反复重测。本原创题本与双语指南未建立心理测量验证、人群常模或跨语言等价。文化资料支持历法事实和有限的传统背景，不支持本版虚构的角色—星期、视角—市日配对。结果不决定命运、匹配、健康、婚期或他人性格。真实日期参考与虚构故事偏好可以不同，彼此无需纠正。

paragraphs.en: The Host role pays attention to how someone can enter a shared scene without having to guess every custom. This role concerns an invitation with a usable boundary. It does not mean you are always sociable, responsible for everyone’s feelings or available to visitors. Imagine that two stalls use the same path at different times. The pairing asks what you would want to make visible in that scene, without saying that the characters were born on this calendar combination. The names organise an invented reading, not an official Primbon character description, a validated personality type or a statement about Javanese people. You may enjoy the combination, disagree with it or read another guide without changing any private answers.

title.en: The weekday role in this edition

paragraphs.en: The Mapper role wants a relationship between places, people or versions to become visible. Its map can be a rough sketch rather than a precise geographical instrument. You might draw the path an object took, mark two equally acceptable routes or connect the people who contributed to a shared exhibit. The attraction is to a helpful arrangement of relationships, not to controlling where everybody must go. A map can omit private locations and keep alternatives open. Choosing this role does not establish spatial ability, navigation accuracy or an aptitude for a particular job. It simply records that making connections visible was appealing among the alternatives actually offered.
paragraphs.zh: 联图者想让地点、人物或版本之间的联系看得见。这里的图可以是草稿，并非精密导航工具：画出物件经过的路径、标明两条同样可行的路线，或连接共同展览的贡献者。吸引力在于有用的关系安排，不是控制别人去哪里。图可以省略私人地点，也可以保留替代路线。选择此角色不证明空间能力、导航准确度或职业适合度，只记录在当题选项中，让联系可见比较吸引你。

title.en: The pasaran lens in this edition

paragraphs.en: Agreement directs a fictional scene toward a shared understanding that can be checked. A lending note, an agreed closing time or a short statement of what is being exchanged gives characters something they can accept, question or decline. Pahing indexes this original lens; its documented south association does not establish that people born on that pasaran seek agreement. An appealing arrangement need not be unanimous or permanent. Name what each participant has actually accepted, what is still provisional and what happens when someone changes their mind. A story can become more convincing when it allows an agreement to end without turning the departure into a moral failure.

title.en: A scene specific to this pairing

paragraphs.en: In this particular scene, one possible contribution is to draw the overlap before asking whether any new arrangement is needed. Notice what that leaves undecided: the people involved still control their words, objects and participation. Compare a second version in which the same contribution is unnecessary or unwanted. The difference helps you locate the appeal of the story more precisely than a flattering character label would. You can also move the scene into a purely invented setting, with no real names or personal records. The aim is an interesting comparison, not a recommendation to reproduce the scene or judge somebody who would choose differently.

title.en: A useful counterexample

paragraphs.en: A map can simplify away the reason someone chose an unusual route. A counterexample keeps the detour and its explanation rather than correcting it into the neatest line. Ask who the drawing serves and what it deliberately leaves out. The clearest diagram for one character may be irrelevant or intrusive for another.
paragraphs.zh: 图也可能简化掉别人绕路的理由。反例保留绕行和解释，不把它纠正成最整齐的线。问清图服务谁、刻意省略什么；对一人最清楚的图，对另一人可能无关甚至冒犯。

title.en: Read both choice banks and every tie

paragraphs.en: The first twenty-one comparisons offer three weekday-role actions each. Every role appears nine times, three in each original option position; each pair of roles meets three times. paragraphs.en: The separate calendar reference uses a Gregorian date, a seven-day week and the repeating five-day sequence Legi, Pahing, Pon, Wage, Kliwon. title.en: A private reflection and the edition’s limits

paragraphs.en: If you want to continue privately, write one sentence about what appealed to you in this pairing and one sentence about when it would not help. Keep both sentences provisional; no upload, purchase or repeated attempt is needed. These original prompts and bilingual guides have no established psychometric validation, population norms or cross-language equivalence. Cultural references support calendar facts and a bounded account of tradition, not the invented role-to-day or lens-to-pasaran assignments. The result cannot determine fate, compatibility, health, marriage dates or another person’s character. Your actual date reference and your fictional story preferences may differ; neither needs to correct the other.

paragraphs.en: Minggu Wage is one of this edition’s thirty-five original story combinations. It joins the broker role with an resources lens. Imagine that three stalls want to borrow one spare stand on the same day. The pairing asks what you would want to make visible in that scene, without saying that the characters were born on this calendar combination. The names organise an invented reading, not an official Primbon character description, a validated personality type or a statement about Javanese people. You may enjoy the combination, disagree with it or read another guide without changing any private answers.
paragraphs.zh: Minggu Wage是本版三十五个原创故事组合之一，把协商者角色与物用视角放在一起。想象：三个摊位同一天想借唯一备用架。组合邀请你看这个场景里想让什么变得可见，并不说角色出生于此历日。名称组织原创读法，不是官方Primbon性格、已验证人格类型或对爪哇人的判断。你可以喜欢、不认同或读其他指南，不必改变私人答案。

title.en: The weekday role in this edition

paragraphs.en: The Broker role pays attention to an explicit, revisable arrangement between fictional participants. You might want to clarify who can borrow an object, what each stall is exchanging or how someone can withdraw from a shared plan. The appeal is to an agreement that people can understand and decline. It is not evidence of persuasion ability, commercial success or a duty to settle every conflict. Some differences can remain unresolved, and a workable arrangement may simply allow separate choices. This edition records a preference for that action among offered alternatives; it does not determine what another person owes you or authorise speaking on behalf of a group.
paragraphs.zh: 协商者关注虚构参与者之间明确、可修改的安排：谁能借物、摊位在交换什么、怎样退出共同计划。吸引力是大家能理解、能拒绝的约定，不是说服力、生意成功或调解所有冲突的责任。有些分歧可以暂不解决，可行安排也可以是各自选择。本版只记录所提供行动中的偏好，不决定别人欠你什么，也不授权代表群体发言。

title.en: The pasaran lens in this edition

paragraphs.en: Resources directs a fictional scene toward what is available, who can use it and what should remain unclaimed. A shared shelf, a spare piece of cloth or an accessible resting place can shape the story without becoming a lesson in productivity. Wage indexes this original lens; the documented north association does not provide a resourcefulness scale. An attractive scene may use fewer objects, leave something unused or return a borrowed item. Name the limit that makes the arrangement workable and the person who can change it. Attention to resources need not mean scarcity, thrift, material success or taking responsibility for everybody else’s needs.
paragraphs.zh: 物用视角关注有什么、谁可以使用、哪些应保留不动。共享架、余布、可休息的位置，都能塑造故事，不必变成效率课。Wage索引本原创视角；北方文化关联不提供资源能力量表。合意场景可以少用物、留空或归还借物。说清使安排可行的限制，以及谁可以更改；关注物用不等于匮乏、节俭、物质成功或负责所有人的需要。

title.en: A scene specific to this pairing

paragraphs.en: In this particular scene, one possible contribution is to state the competing requests without allocating anyone else’s property. Notice what that leaves undecided: the people involved still control their words, objects and participation. Compare a second version in which the same contribution is unnecessary or unwanted. The difference helps you locate the appeal of the story more precisely than a flattering character label would. You can also move the scene into a purely invented setting, with no real names or personal records. The aim is an interesting comparison, not a recommendation to reproduce the scene or judge somebody who would choose differently.
paragraphs.zh: 在这个具体场景里，一种贡献是：列清竞争请求，不擅自分配他人财物。同时看它没有替别人决定什么：相关角色仍掌握自己的话、物件和参与。再比较一个同样贡献并不需要、甚至不受欢迎的版本；两者差异，比好听的性格标签更能定位故事吸引力。你也可把它放进完全虚构的地点，不用真实姓名或记录。目标是有趣的比较，不是要求复现场景，或评价不同选择的人。

title.en: A useful counterexample

paragraphs.en: Agreement can become pressure when a character is expected to accept the tidy compromise. A counterexample keeps a genuine option to decline and records a remaining disagreement without blaming anyone. Ask whose consent is needed and whose preferences are still unknown. A quiet unresolved difference may be more honest than an attractive deal.
paragraphs.zh: 当角色被期待接受整齐折中，约定也会成为压力。反例保留真正的拒绝选项，记录剩余分歧而不责怪任何人。问需要谁同意、谁的偏好仍未知；安静而未解决的差异，可能比漂亮交易更诚实。

title.en: Read both choice banks and every tie
title.zh: 分别阅读两组计数与全部并列

paragraphs.en: The first twenty-one comparisons offer three weekday-role actions each. Every role appears nine times, three in each original option position; each pair of roles meets three times. The remaining fourteen comparisons offer all five pasaran lenses each time. Choose one offered action to add one count to its key. Compare the two banks separately: their counts sum to twenty-one and fourteen, so they must not be combined into one ranking. Every highest weekday role is paired with every highest pasaran lens. For example, two tied roles and two tied lenses produce four full readings. Any unscored answer withholds both personal rankings, without filling in zero or guessing a winner.
paragraphs.zh: 前二十一题每题提供三个星期角色行动，每角色出现九次，在原始各位置各三次；每对角色同场三次。后十四题每题提供全部五个市日视角。选中行动给对应键加一次。两组分别比较：计数合计分别二十一与十四，不混成一个排名。每个最高星期角色与每个最高市日视角都组合，例如两角色并列、两视角并列，显示四篇全文。任一未评分会暂不显示两组任何个人计数、排名或匹配，不补零、不猜赢家。

title.en: Calendar, neptu and sunset reference

paragraphs.en: The separate calendar reference uses a Gregorian date, a seven-day week and the repeating five-day sequence Legi, Pahing, Pon, Wage, Kliwon. For Minggu Wage, the displayed neptu reference is 5 + 4 = 9; this is a conventional sum, not an energy score. The cited Yogyakarta heritage account associates Wage with the north. That is cultural context, not a lucky travel direction. Because a traditional day begins at local sunset, an unknown relation to sunset leaves two possible references. No fixed clock time, device timezone or birth personality is inferred, and a date calculation never changes story counts.
paragraphs.zh: 独立历法工具使用公历日期、七日星期，以及Legi、Pahing、Pon、Wage、Kliwon五日循环。Minggu Wage的neptu参考为5＋4＝9，这是传统数字相加，不是能量分。所引日惹遗产资料把Wage与北方关联；这是文化背景，不是个人吉利行进方向。传统日界在当地日落，无法确认与日落关系时保留两个可能参考，不猜固定钟点、设备时区或出生人格；日期计算也不改变故事计数。

title.en: A private reflection and the edition’s limits

paragraphs.en: If you want to continue privately, write one sentence about what appealed to you in this pairing and one sentence about when it would not help. Keep both sentences provisional; no upload, purchase or repeated attempt is needed. These original prompts and bilingual guides have no established psychometric validation, population norms or cross-language equivalence. Cultural references support calendar facts and a bounded account of tradition, not the invented role-to-day or lens-to-pasaran assignments. The result cannot determine fate, compatibility, health, marriage dates or another person’s character. Your actual date reference and your fictional story preferences may differ; neither needs to correct the other.
paragraphs.zh: 若想私下继续，写一句这个组合哪里吸引你，再写一句它何时不合适，两句都暂时保留；无需上传、购买或反复重测。本原创题本与双语指南未建立心理测量验证、人群常模或跨语言等价。文化资料支持历法事实和有限的传统背景，不支持本版虚构的角色—星期、视角—市日配对。结果不决定命运、匹配、健康、婚期或他人性格。真实日期参考与虚构故事偏好可以不同，彼此无需纠正。

title.en: Two original story banks, one separate calendar
title.zh: 两组原创故事，一项独立历法

paragraphs.en: Choose the contribution or focus you would most like to try in 35 fictional scenes. The first 21 choices compare seven original weekday roles, each offered nine times. The next 14 compare five original pasaran lenses, each offered fourteen times. These assignments are FermatMind story devices, not traditional personality keys. Complete all 35 responses; any unscored choice withholds both personal rankings while all 35 full guides remain public. Every highest role is paired with every highest lens, without a forced single winner. Alternatives shuffle after Start and stay stable while going back. A separate optional Gregorian date reference uses explicit relation to local sunset; it never changes story results. No birthdate is required for the quiz.

answer.en: No birthdate is needed for the fictional-choice quiz. Its original story result and the optional calendar reference are separate and may differ. Neither assigns a birth personality.
answer.zh: 虚构选择问卷不需要生日；原创故事结果与可选历法参考独立，可以不同，都不分配出生人格。

question.en: What happens to ties or an unscored response?
question.zh: 并列或未评分怎样处理？

answer.en: All35 responses are required. Every highest role pairs with every highest lens, and each matched eight-section guide opens in full. Any unscored response withholds every personal count and match; all35 public guides remain available.
answer.zh: 需要回应全部35题；全部最高角色与全部最高视角交叉，每篇匹配八节全文完整展开。任一未评分不显示全部个人计数与匹配，35篇公开指南仍可阅读。

question.en: Why can the calendar show two references?
question.zh: 历法为什么可能显示两个参考？

answer.en: A traditional day begins at local sunset. Choose before or after only if you know that relation; unknown keeps the entered date and following-date possibilities. No fixed sunset hour or device timezone is guessed.
answer.zh: 传统日界在当地日落。只有确知关系才选之前或之后；未知会保留输入日期与后一天的两种可能，不猜固定日落钟点或设备时区。

question.zh: 这些是官方传统性格吗？
